contract.main_s0: Both-view valid & finite & confidence>=0.3 & native bounds intersection, unchanged original usable.
contract.original_only_comparator: Original valid & finite & confidence>=0.3 & native bounds; all s0 corners from frames with >=6.
contract.both_view_comparator: All main s0 corners from frames with >=6; no PnP/LOO/error gate.
contract.hypothesis_selection: Original choose on all original candidate results, THEN expose fixed selected-hypothesis stages. Conditional diagnostics; no stage-specific reselection.
contract.fixed_statistics: Same original RANSAC I, projected D, per-fold LOO errors, and medians over original I. No refits or median recomputation.
contract.noflip: Original-only s0 -> s1 -> s2 -> final; s3 not applicable.
contract.frame_counts: Report frames_nonempty and frames_ge6 separately; final requires >=6.
